# Postmark Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Postmark Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.postmarktrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the Postmark Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Postmark Trigger node into your workflows.

[Postmark](https://postmarkapp.com) helps deliver and track application email. You can track statistics such as the number of emails sent or processed, opens, bounces and, spam complaints.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Postmark credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/postmark) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}

{% endhint %}
